next_unit_hint: The honest denominator for H1 is 2 p95 values, both pointer-stable, in 2 single-arm tools grids (G8 n=70 = 46 turn + 24 follow-up; G9 n=61 = 37 turn + 24 follow-up), intervals overlapping; 0 p95 arm-versus-arm differences. To produce a third p95 that is not duplicate-inflated, a cell needs >=60 independent request rows with a TTFT in ONE grid, and >=60 TURN rows if the number is to be quoted as a turn-level p95. G7 cannot supply it: at n=51 de-duplicated it is 9 samples short.

assumptions.what: p95 n counts request rows with a TTFT (turn + tool-follow-up), not turn rows only

The turn-only counts are reported beside each cell so the denominator cannot be mistaken for a turn-level one.
